text:
If you've been waiting for a stretch of easy, dry summer days, today's the one to build around. High pressure's in charge, so it's sunny with a high right around 85 and none of yesterday's mugginess, the air's genuinely comfortable for once. Wind stays light out of the west, swinging southeast on the lake later, so the waterfront should be calm all day, waves a foot or less. Water's holding at 74, still good swimming temp if you want to get in.

Wednesday looks like a repeat, sunny and a touch warmer near 87, with south wind picking up just enough to add a small chop, one to two feet on the broad waters by afternoon. Models are tight on both days, no real argument about the forecast holding. Enjoy it while it lasts, because the discussion's already flagging showers and thunderstorms returning by the weekend. Good call for today: full sun all day, comfortable evening on the water with light wind through sunset around 8:14.

week.blurb: Sunny and comfortable with low humidity, a high near 85, about as good as summer gets.
Another sunny day, high near 87, though the American model hints it could run a touch warmer.
Thunderstorms likely by afternoon, high near 88, and I'd lean toward the wetter European model on this one.
Showers and thunderstorms likely again, high near 87, so keep the rain plans flexible.
Still unsettled with a decent chance of afternoon storms, high near 87.
Mostly sunny for most of the day, high near 88, with just a slight chance of storms after 2pm.
Trending toward another round of showers, high near 86, as the unsettled pattern holds.
